privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Transparent, offline-first, and respectful of pilgrim privacy.
privacy.lastUpdated: Last updated: August 2026 for Nashik Kumbh Mela 2027
privacy.heroDesc: Yatriva is built to serve pilgrims with utmost privacy. We do not sell your personal data, run intrusive trackers, or display third-party advertisements.
privacy.localStorageDesc: By default, your saved preferences, language selection, and offline emergency data remain stored strictly in your browser's local storage and are never uploaded to any remote server without your explicit action.
privacy.locationDesc: When you grant GPS location access, your coordinates are processed strictly on your device to calculate distances to the nearest Ghats, medical posts, and parking zones. Your live location is never tracked, stored in a database, or shared with third parties.
privacy.familySafetyDesc: The optional Family & Group Safety tool generates printable emergency QR cards to protect separated children and elderly relatives. Emergency phone numbers in QR tokens are used solely for rapid reunification during crowd surges.
privacy.aiPrivacyDesc: Queries asked to the AI Assistant are processed to retrieve grounded pilgrimage information (bathing dates, bus routes, temple timings). We do not store queries tied to personal identities.
privacy.noAdsDesc: Yatriva is an independent community initiative. We do not monetize pilgrim information, partner with commercial data brokers, or host tracking advertising scripts.
privacy.retentionDesc: You retain 100% control over your data. You can purge all cached data and group registrations at any time via the registration dashboard or by clearing your browser cache.

crowdSafety.title: Crowd-Crush & Surge Safety
crowdSafety.subtitle: Essential life-saving rules for high-density Kumbh Mela gatherings
crowdSafety.historicalContext: Evergreen safety protocols developed from historical Kumbh crowd dynamics to keep every pilgrim and family safe.
crowdSafety.disclaimer: This is general educational public-safety advice. In all situations on ground, immediately follow the direct commands of Police, NDRF, SDRF, and designated Kumbh Mela security personnel.

waterEdge.title: Never Sit or Sleep at the Water's Edge
waterEdge.rule: Avoid resting or sleeping along the immediate riverbank steps during peak Amrit Snan days.
waterEdge.reason: Sudden dawn or night crowds rushing toward holy waters can cause fatal trampling before people on the ground can stand up.

diagonal.title: Move Diagonally with the Crowd Surge
diagonal.rule: If caught in a sudden crowd wave, keep your feet moving and drift diagonally toward the sides.
diagonal.reason: Never push straight against the crowd surge. Keep your arms bent across your chest like a boxer to preserve breathing space.

handsFree.title: Keep Hands Free & Protect Children
handsFree.rule: Do not carry bags across your chest or hold young children by the hand alone in thick crowds.
handsFree.reason: Carry children securely high on shoulders or keep them positioned between two adults to shield them from lateral compression.

fallAction.title: If You Fall, Rise or Move to Fixed Structures
fallAction.rule: Get back on your feet immediately. If unable to stand, curl into a ball protecting your head and crawl toward a solid pillar or railing.
fallAction.reason: Staying flat on open ground makes you invisible to moving crowds. Fixed structures provide structural protection against surges.

exitRoutes.title: Spot Your Nearest Exits Before Entering Ghats
exitRoutes.rule: Identify alternate side evacuation paths and emergency exits before entering dense ghat areas.
exitRoutes.reason: Entry gates frequently become congested bottlenecks. Knowing two exit routes allows rapid departure if density spikes.

mapBanner.alert: High-Density Amrit Snan Advisory: Review crowd safety guidelines before visiting Ramkund or Kushavarta.

weatherHealth.title: Weather, Heat & Pilgrim Health
weatherHealth.subtitle: Real-time weather advisory, hydration points, heat exhaustion prevention, and essential packing
weatherHealth.waterKiosksTitle: Free RO Drinking Water Points (जल सेवा)
weatherHealth.waterKiosksDesc: 250+ community water distribution kiosks and ORS electrolyte booths across the Mela area.
weatherHealth.heatstrokeSymptoms: Symptoms: Dizziness, rapid pulse, heavy sweating, muscle cramps, extreme thirst.
weatherHealth.heatstrokeAction: Action: Move to shade immediately, loosen tight clothing, sip cool ORS water, and visit the nearest medical post.
weatherHealth.checkWater: Reusable water bottle or hydration pouch
weatherHealth.checkRain: Compact umbrella or light raincoat (monsoon showers)
weatherHealth.checkID: Laminated Pilgrim Safety Card / ID Card with emergency contacts
weatherHealth.checkCash: Cash buffer (digital UPI networks may face network delays in dense crowds)
weatherHealth.checkFootwear: Comfortable non-slip walking shoes or sandals
